title: Create: High Pressure - Reimagined
description: Give your diamond factory a new look. A complete texture overhaul for Create: High Pressure, with crisp, modernized visuals and Portuguese (BR) translation.
body:
A complete texture overhaul for Create: High Pressure

The small Create addon that lets you build your own self-sustainable diamond factory. Every texture has been recreated from scratch with a modern, polished look. Includes Portuguese (BR) translation.
